profile.headline: Experience in Technical Leadership, Solutions, Architecture Design & Development
profile.summary: I specialize in robust backend development, cloud architecture, and scalable enterprise portal solutions. Throughout my career, I have focused on designing and delivering high-performance APIs and microservices that align technical execution with business needs. My core expertise spans Java, Spring Boot, and AWS, with hands-on experience leading large-scale cloud migrations, implementing data caching strategies, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines. From automating deployments with Docker to integrating services like DynamoDB and S3, I build practical, maintainable systems engineered for reliability. I thrive on solving complex technical challenges and look forward to bringing this expertise to teams focused on shipping efficient, high-impact software.

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development, deployment, unit testing and documentation. Developed a Java Swing GUI for SAS macro programming to automate macro-code generation for dataset processes such as Transpose, Collapse, Split, and Append. designed features, business logic, database structures, deployment, and unit testing.

positions.title: Software programmer
positions.description:
Developed innovative software solutions for e-commerce platforms at Infibeam.com using JSP, Struts 2.0, Java, Hibernate, 
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery, enhancing user experience and system functionality while collaborating on business logic, database structures, email templates, unit testing, and deployment.
